name: What are common missteps to avoid when planning energy-efficient upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What are common missteps to avoid when planning energy-efficient upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common missteps when planning energy-efficient upgrades include failing to conduct a home energy audit, which can lead to misdiagnosing the biggest energy loss areas. Another pitfall is neglecting air sealing while upgrading insulation, as unsealed leaks can undermine insulation's effectiveness. Over-relying on a single solution, like just replacing windows, without addressing other issues is also a frequent error. Finally, choosing uncertified contractors or not verifying product specifications can lead to subpar results. At Hometelligent Inc., we emphasize a holistic approach, starting with a thorough assessment to ensure all improvements work synergistically for optimal savings and comfort.
